## 2. North star & how we prioritized

**North star:** be the best resource on the planet for CSAM prevention and protecting people from pornography-related harm — **found** by the words people actually type, **believed** because every claim is sourced and dated, **usable in a crisis** in seconds and safely, and **reusable by allies**. Help-first; the privacy and safety of distressed visitors come before everything else.

**Prioritization rule (heuristic, not an owner quote):** rank every initiative by **expected IMPACT = REACH × HELP** — REACH = how many distressed people or allies the work puts help in front of (organic-discovery surface, syndication multiplier, query-intent match, learned post-ship from **GSC only**); HELP = the conditional lift that a reached person is genuinely helped (crisis-routing quality, comprehension, credibility, concrete actionability). **Multiply, not add** — vanity reach with weak help and deep help that's unfindable both get demoted. Tie-breakers: (1) fastest time-to-help / lowest effort, (2) unblocks or multiplies other work, (3) reversibility/safety on crisis routes. Hard demotions: pure internal polish (reach×help ≈ 0) and anything blocked-on-owner (can't ship predictably).

---

## 3. What changed because of the decisions

Versus the canonical PM-council roadmap (`V3-COUNCIL-2026-05-31.md`):

1. **ALL internationalization → v4.** The entire i18n program leaves the v3 universe and is re-bucketed to v4 (full list in §7): `[lang]` routing/middleware + multi-locale URLs; ES/ZH translation of crisis path, core report, and audience guides; translation memory/source-of-truth workflow; **localized search** + per-language crisis-intent routing; translation governance (reviewer/QA, locale fallback, hreflang/alternate-language JSON-LD); the **heavyweight** per-country hotline registry + `CountrySelector` + geolocation + localized hotline copy. This vacates the single largest block of engineering + content + governance effort.

2. **Freed i18n effort redirected** into: **Reach** (JSON-LD/schema substrate, honest sitemap, canonical/OG, glossary, FAQ, breadcrumbs), **Content depth** (per-platform app-safety guide, condition deep-dives, research library, youth-exposure stats, therapy guide), **Trust** (methodology/corrections/no-analytics posture, citation discipline), **Crisis-grade UX** (Quick-Exit, ExternalLink a11y, crisis-routed search), and the **Distribution flagship** (pulled forward and committed full).

3. **On-site analytics initiative CUT** (D2). Replaced by a one-line published posture on `/editorial-standards` + a content-invariant that fails the build if any tracker `<script>` appears. GSC is the sole reach feedback loop.

4. **Review board demoted to BLOCKED-ON-OWNER** (D3). Only the **dark** byline data model is in scope across v2.1/v2.5/v3.0 (built once, kept dark). All public "Reviewed by" / "review in progress" rendering is removed from the v3 plan; authority carried by citations + methodology until reviewers sign.

5. **Distribution stays FULL and is committed** (D4) — widget + cite-kit + fact cards + dataset/API + `/partners` — landing in v3.0, sequenced after the JSON-LD/dataset substrate (v2.1–v2.5) it depends on.

6. **Light international-hotline awareness kept in v3 as content** (D1 judgment call) — appears once as a small static English block reused across `/get-help`, `/help-now`, `/for-reporting`, and baked into the v3.0 widget.

7. **Server build confirmed; static-export question resolved** (F1) — stops consuming planning cycles.

**Honest rebalance note:** with i18n gone, **v2.5 and v3.0 are materially lighter**. v2.5 loses the `[lang]` foundation + hotline registry (both XL/L); v3.0 loses crisis-path translation, translation governance, localized search, and core-report translation (the bulk of the old flagship). The recovered capacity is spent **pulling Reach/Content forward into v2.2/v2.5** and **committing the full distribution flagship** in v3.0 rather than as an exploration — so each release still ships a step-change without slipping the cycle.

v2.2  content-glossary (FIRST; integration-owner of PAGE_REGISTRY + sitemap + browse)
        ├─parallel→ reach-faq, reach-og-cards
        ├─serial(merge)→ content-platform-safety, content-therapy(+youth-stats parallel)
        └─then→ reach-breadcrumbs-chapter-schema (after faq AND the 3 route branches; needs honest dates)

        └─then parallel→ guides(B), depth-conditions(C), methodology(M), research-library(D), international-help(E)

**Hard serial edges (do not reorder):**
- v2.1 `reach-schema` **before** `crisis-ux` (shared `app/layout.tsx`).
- v2.1 JSON-LD schema helper **before** all v2.2 schema consumers (glossary DefinedTerm, FAQPage, breadcrumb, chapter Article).
- v2.1 honest git-derived dates **before** v2.2 chapter `datePublished/dateModified` and the v2.5 changelog/cite-date work.
- v2.2 `content-glossary` **before** the other route-adding v2.2 branches (it owns PAGE_REGISTRY/sitemap/browse) and **before** breadcrumbs (trails must include new routes); **fix nav-label drift before breadcrumbs**.
- v2.5 `foundations` **before** every other v2.5 worktree (sole writer of `lib/schema.ts`, `lib/site.ts`, `content/types.ts`, scripts, package.json).

- The deploy/CI harness (v2.1 + v2.5 stabilization) should be green **before** the v3.0 flagship ships its larger surface.

**What runs concurrently at each stage:** v2.1 = up to **3 worktrees in parallel** after schema lands (crisis-ux ‖ trust-standards ‖ deploy-hardening). v2.2 = up to **3** (glossary ‖ faq ‖ og-cards), then platform/therapy/youth-stats fan out. v2.5 = **5 content worktrees in parallel** after foundations. v3.0 = **3 in parallel** (widget ‖ og-cards ‖ data-and-cite), then partners.

## 8. Definition of done for v3

v3 has shipped when, **English-only and under the four locked decisions**, all of the following are true:

1. **Found.** Every route emits valid, build-validated JSON-LD (Organization + WebSite SearchAction sitewide; Article/MedicalWebPage on chapters; DefinedTerm on glossary; FAQPage on the 5+ high-intent guides; BreadcrumbList on deep routes; Dataset on `/data`). The sitemap's `lastModified` is **git-derived per route** (no mass per-deploy update), and every page has a unique canonical + dignified OG card. Glossary (≥40 terms), FAQ, breadcrumbs, the per-platform app-safety guide, condition deep-dives, the research library, the therapy guide, and youth-exposure stats are all live, registered in `PAGE_REGISTRY`, and findable via the **rewritten** on-site search index.
2. **Safe to land on.** A persistent, zero-network **Quick-Exit** works on 100% of routes (double-Esc + control, history scrub); all external links carry unique aria-labels with silent decorative arrows; crisis-routed search ranks help/reporting pages first for plain-language crisis queries; a light static **English international-hotline** path (INHOPE/ICMEC + major-country lines, source-verified) is reachable from `/get-help`, `/help-now`, `/for-reporting`, and the widget — with **zero tracking on any crisis route** (network-tab verified).
3. **Believed.** `/editorial-standards` publishes the **no-on-site-analytics** posture + corrections policy; `/methodology` documents sourcing/evidence/uncertainty with stable deep-link anchors; the ICD-11 6C72 framing is stated and the skeptics framing is absent everywhere; content carries primary-sourced, currency-checked citations; the **deployed site ships zero analytics/3rd-party requests** (enforced by `content-invariants.mjs`).
